name: options
use_for: Asking the owner to choose between options.
guide:
Use this when you need the owner to decide. Posting it also asks a question whose choices are the option titles.

- **question**: the decision, as a question ending in "?".
- **options**: 2-6 options. Each has a short `title` (this is the button text), a `text` explaining it, and `pros` and `cons`.
- **recommendation**: a callout with the option you would pick and why.
- **context**: background the owner needs, if any.

Tips: make titles short and distinct ("Postgres", "SQLite"). Put your recommended option first.

slots.name: recommendation
slots.label: Recommendation
slots.hint: Which you would pick and why

example.question: Which database should the trial mode use?

options.title: SQLite
options.text: One file next to the binary.
cons: Needs a migration path to Postgres

options.title: Embedded Postgres
options.text: Download and run Postgres on first start.

recommendation.text: **SQLite**: the trial should start in under a minute.

example.context: Trial mode is the `cadenza serve --trial` path: one user, local only, started from the README.
